entities.name: Session management procedures
entities.description: Procedures defined over 3GPP access that are re-used over non-3GPP access with specific exceptions.

entities.name: Non-3GPP access
entities.description: Access type where certain session management procedures and features do not apply.

entities.name: Serving PLMN rate control
entities.description: Rate control mechanism that does not apply for non-3GPP access.

entities.name: Small data rate control
entities.description: Rate control mechanism for small data that does not apply for non-3GPP access.

entities.name: Handling of 5GSM cause value #82
entities.description: Procedure for handling cause value #82 'maximum data rate per UE for user-plane integrity protection is too low' that does not apply for non-3GPP access.

entities.name: MBS
entities.description: Multicast/broadcast service that does not apply for non-3GPP access.

entities.name: Redundant PDU sessions
entities.description: Support for redundant PDU sessions that does not apply for non-3GPP access.

relations.description: Session management procedures are re-used over non-3GPP access with exceptions.
Non-3GPP access establishes that serving PLMN rate control does not apply.
Non-3GPP access establishes that small data rate control does not apply.
Non-3GPP access establishes that handling of 5GSM cause value #82 does not apply.
Non-3GPP access establishes that MBS does not apply.
Non-3GPP access establishes that support of redundant PDU sessions does not apply.
